title: mdm.product.changed.v1
description: A product's complete current state (a full-state event), with its own unit conversions and its availability by legal entity; the record ID is its UUIDv7, never reused. Also the data of SourceService for AGGREGATE_PRODUCT.

stocked.description: takes part in inventory: true for stock only (a service order asks for no stock)

base_unit.description: a unit code of the catalog (UN/ECE Recommendation 20)

has_movements.description: inventory has recorded movements of it: tracking and base unit no longer change (a new product and a migration instead)

conversions.description: the product's own conversions; they come before the catalog's

factor.description: one unit is factor base units

availability.description: by legal entity: whether new sales and purchase documents may use it
